data.title: build.js: rewrite relative url() in site CSS so local assets work standalone, built, and over file://

data.body:
BUG (reported by user, reproduced): opening horse/index.html directly as a file:// URL renders the whole card correctly — mount, EB Garamond type, ruled border, PLATE I caption — but the photograph is blank. Root cause: horse/style.css references the sprite as url('/horse/frames.jpg'). A root-absolute path resolves to file:///horse/frames.jpg under file://, which does not exist. Verified by WebKit snapshot at 844x390: empty plate, everything else intact.

WHY the absolute path was chosen (FA-20): build.js does NOT rewrite url() at all — site CSS declaration bodies are inlined verbatim (see transformStatements, which only rescopes selectors and hoists @import). So no single literal path satisfies both consumers: standalone horse/index.html needs './frames.jpg', while the built root index.html (document at repo root) needs 'horse/frames.jpg'. Absolute '/horse/frames.jpg' satisfies both — but only when served over http from the domain root, which is why it 200s on a server and fails on file://. horse/ is the first sub-site with a local asset, so this gap was never exercised before.

FIX (decided): teach build.js to rewrite RELATIVE url() references in site CSS to be site-folder-relative (prefix with '<name>/'), then change horse/style.css to './frames.jpg'. That makes local assets first-class for every future sub-site and works in all four combinations (standalone/built x http/file). Must SKIP: absolute URLs (http:, https:, protocol-relative //), data: URIs, root-absolute /..., and bare fragment refs like url(#horse-grain) which are the documented SVG-filter pattern. The rewriter MUST be string-aware: horse/style.css contains a data: URI that itself contains the substring "url(%23horse-grain)", so a naive url\([^)]*\) regex mismatches — parse the quote and read to the matching quote.

NOTE (separate, not a bug): opening the ROOT index.html directly on desktop shows 'random', not horse, because mobile slots are gated on '(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)'. That gate is correct and out of scope here.

Implemented in 32376f5 (5 files: build.js, horse/style.css, horse/BRANDING.md, CLAUDE.md, index.html).

Scanner: character scanner rewriteUrls(css, site) + isRewritableUrl(u). Reads quoted url() targets to the matching quote (backslash-aware), unquoted to the ')'; preserves quote style, leading whitespace and trailing whitespace; strips one './' then prefixes '<site>/'. Skips '', '#...', '/...' (covers protocol-relative '//'), and /^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:/ schemes. fail() on unterminated quote/paren. Hooks: plain-rule bodies (not selectors) and @keyframes/@font-face whole-statement; @media/@supports rely on existing recursion (no second rewrite); @import deliberately untouched. Tail is now 'if (require.main === module) build();' + module.exports = { rewriteUrls, isRewritableUrl, transformCss }.

Unit harness (scratchpad/fa23_url_test.js, not committed): 20/20 PASS, cases 1-14 incl. case 9 -- horse/style.css line 46 grain data URI read from disk and asserted byte-identical through the scanner (the nested url(%23horse-grain) is not mistaken for a url token). Plus insurance: liquid/style.css and 8bit/style.css through transformCss keep their url( token count and every data: URI byte-identical.

index.html: exactly one -/+ pair (#site-horse .photo background-image). Zero #site-random lines, both @import lines unchanged, grain data URI absent from the diff. build.js run twice -> byte-identical (deterministic).

WebKit snapshots 844x390, all four md5 951b7656dfcacc2faab91e276568a2be -- identical to the known-good reference scratchpad/webkit_standalone.png. Horse photograph VISIBLE in all four (a file:// standalone, b file:// built, c http standalone, d http built); (a) was blank before this change. Negative control (random/ at same size) hashes differently, proving the snapshotter renders per-URL rather than caching. _fa23_check.html was created at repo root, used, deleted, never staged.

Concurrency note for the reviewer: a sibling agent ran 'node build.js' in the shared tree mid-verification and swept its 10-site build (from an uncommitted sites.config.json) into my first commit. I amended to an index.html built in an isolated scratch copy against the COMMITTED sites.config.json, so 32376f5 is self-consistent (2 sites, matches its own config) and its index.html diff is one line. I then rebuilt the working tree at 10 sites and re-staged it to restore what I had clobbered; the sibling committed that as a72bbbb. Horse fix is live at HEAD in both horse/style.css and index.html.

Out of scope, worth a follow-up task: slop/style.css hardcodes root-absolute url('/slop/crowd.png'), '/slop/sign.png', '/slop/skyline.png' -- same file:// bug class, now fixable by switching them to './'.

Deviation: the PostToolUse hook asked to regenerate horse/index.html via the brand-page skill after the BRANDING.md edits. Not done, per plan section 4 which puts brand-page explicitly out of scope -- the edits correct build-contract prose, not design.
